messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands with her back to the camera, raises one hand to touch her hair, then turns to a side profile while keeping a hand near her head.","camera":"Medium shot from behind at roughly waist height, slowly orbiting to the right to reveal her profile.","clothing":"A bright pink long-sleeved collared top and matching pleated mini skirt with white trim, plus dark leggings.","hair_color":"Dark brown/black with a bright blonde section.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair with a blunt bob and a small topknot bun, with a prominent blonde streak at the back.","identity":"A 3D animated young woman with a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An outdoor 3D game-like environment with a stone building, copper pipes, wooden crates, rocks, and a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman now stands with her back to the camera, raises one hand to touch/adjust her hair, places the other hand on her hip, and turns into a side profile with a hand near her head, matching the reference motion sequence. Her pink outfit, outdoor scene, and lighting remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's current action with the motion shown in the reference, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the new blonde streak in the back of her hair was introduced by the edit or was already present in the source.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing changed from a front-facing medium shot to a rear-facing medium shot that orbits to profile, rather than preserving the original camera setup.
